systems.system: Plan Directeur de Digitalisation des Services Publics (PDDSP 2023-2033)
systems.owner: Prime Minister's steering committee (CNPDSP), decree 100/012 of 2025-01-27

BDI.note: The decree names a steering committee for the PDDSP 2023-2033, a public-services digitalisation plan (government class, not assessed); it does not describe a national strategy.
